Movement.subject: One Asset with independent before/proposed-after values per OperationItem
Movement.fieldContract: Deliver typed allowed changed fields per operation; preserve explicit keep/clear distinction

InventoryTransfer.subject: One logical quantity transfer links both balance effects under the same OperationItem
constraints: Valid positive transfer amount under final unit/precision contract
Versioned effects and recovery for uncertain partial writes

crossEntityConstraints: Function belongs to Organization; operational scope/query projections must agree with authoritative parent relationships
AssetType belongs to Asset Organization and references one fixed Category
Building is shared; it has no exclusive Organization/Function parent and no floor/room fields
Asset AccountingAssetCode company uniqueness must be enforced under concurrent creation after canonicalization policy is defined; no duplicate serial prohibition
BusinessOwner is a real directory principal; PendingDirectory Custodian creates no principal, grant or routing identity
Approval capacities and response identity/attempt/snapshot are validated separately from operational roles
StockResponse modifies assigned evidence only; review, verification, master correction and sign-off remain separate
Reconciliation final review snapshot follows actual correction application; transfer-specific approvals still precede those transactions
Lifecycle and outcome/history references survive disposal; no ordinary cascade-delete of business evidence
All read/export/history projections enforce row and field visibility; snapshot existence is not general visibility
